Business details, backup, integrations & role reference
🏢 Business Details
Stored on this device (browser storage) and applied to the login screen and sidebar immediately.
📊 Google Sheet Backup
Writes into your existing spreadsheet — open it here — never a new one. Slot Bookings, each Coaching sport, and Café Sales each get their own auto-created monthly sheet (e.g. "Slot Bookings - Jul 2026"), so nothing is ever mixed together.
⚠️ This device is using a different Apps Script URL than the one built into this app. That likely means it's talking to an old/stale deployment.
Stops random people who guess your Apps Script URL from writing into your sheet. Set the same value in Code.gs's SHARED_SECRET constant.
Every booking create/edit/cancel, coaching fee payment, and café sale auto-posts here once set. Need the Apps Script code? It's the separate DDTZ_Apps_Script_Code.gs file provided alongside this app — paste it into Extensions → Apps Script on that spreadsheet and deploy as a Web App to get this URL, then use Test Connection above to confirm it's working before relying on it.

🤖 Automatic Server-Side Backup (Google Apps Script)
Runs on Google's servers, independent of any browser or device — unlike the local snapshots above, this keeps working even if this admin panel is never opened. Once a day it makes a full copy of the entire spreadsheet (every tab) into a separate "DD Turf Zone Backups" Drive folder, verifies the copy, and logs the result below. Requires the updated Code.gs to be deployed (Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version) — this feature does nothing until that's done.

📥 Import Data
Migrate existing records from Excel (.xlsx) or CSV into DD Turf Zone. Every imported record is validated, checked against what's already here to skip duplicates, saved locally, and then automatically synced to Google Sheets — same as a record created directly in the app.
The Wizard adds column mapping, validation, duplicate-handling options, a preview before anything is saved, and one-click undo — useful for larger or messier files. The simple importer above still works exactly as before.
💾 Backup Settings
Manual on-demand Excel backups are available from Bookings and Reports. Browsers can't write files to disk automatically for security reasons — this reminder is the closest safe equivalent to "automatic" backups.
☠️ Danger Zone — Coaching Module Reset
Permanently deletes ALL Students, Attendance, Fee Collection, Due Adjustments, and Coach Settlement data — from Google Sheets, Firebase, AND this device's local cache — in one controlled operation. A full backup (downloaded as a JSON file) is created automatically before anything is deleted.

Not touched: Slot Bookings, Booking Requests, Café, Finance Expenses, Coaches (the roster itself — only generated settlement documents are cleared), Users, Settings.
